name: Placeholder scDNA-seq
description: SCHEMA EXAMPLE, not a design. Generic single-cell DNA workflow shape with two heat steps, here so the schema, the planner and the twin have something to chew on. Every reagent, time and temperature is a placeholder. The VOLUMES are not arbitrary: every exchange declares what it is FOR in `exchange_kind` and is sized from that against chip/placeholder_chip_spec.json. There is one `fill` - step 1 loads a dry chamber - and everything after it goes into liquid that is already there, so it is a `sweep`: 4.61 chamber volumes in total, which is -ln(1 - 0.99) for the 99% exchange.target_fraction in contracts/parameters.json, because a well-mixed chamber keeps exp(-V) of its old liquid after V chamber volumes. Nothing here is a `partial`: a reagent swap that leaves a third of the previous buffer behind is not a deliberate fractional change, it is a wash that did not finish. These chambers hold capsules, not adherent cells, so the culture shear ceiling does not apply to them; the bound is capsule.escape_pressure_kpa across the weir, and 50 uL/min puts about 2.5 kPa across a full capsule bed - half the escape pressure, and inside the 0.7 planning margin. The old 100 uL/min sat exactly ON the escape pressure.

steps.note: Load the capsule suspension into the exchange chamber. One chamber volume: a load FILLS the chamber, so the chamber's own volume (3.638 uL) is the only sensible number. This step used to say 100 uL, 27x what the chamber holds.
Wash the capsules twice with wash buffer. SWEEP: 2.31 chamber volumes per wash, 4.62 in total, which is what the 99% exchange goal needs.

Swap in lysis buffer to open the cells. SWEEP, not a fill: the chamber is full of wash buffer, so one chamber volume would leave over a third of it behind and dilute the lysis chemistry by the same share. 4.62 chamber volumes in one pass.
Exchange into the digest mix. SWEEP: an enzyme mix has to arrive undiluted, and lysis buffer left behind would be carried into a 50 C incubation.
Hold warm while the digest runs.
Heat the chamber to stop the digest.
Exchange into the amplification mix. SWEEP: the heat-killed digest has to leave, so this clears the chamber rather than filling it.
Split the capsules evenly into the four split chambers.

Give split chamber 1 reagent E. SWEEP of the SPLIT chamber: 4.63 of its 1.273 uL volumes, not of the exchange chamber's. The point of a split is that the four get DIFFERENT reagents, so carryover is what would blur them together.
Give split chamber 2 reagent F. SWEEP: 4.63 split-chamber volumes.
Give split chamber 3 reagent G. SWEEP: 4.63 split-chamber volumes.
Give split chamber 4 reagent H. SWEEP: 4.63 split-chamber volumes.
Pool all the capsules into one chamber.
Wash the pooled capsules twice. SWEEP: 2.3 pool-chamber volumes (2.911 uL each) per wash, 4.6 in total.
Release the library and send it to the outlet. 3.9 pool-chamber volumes, which is -ln(1 - 0.98) for the release.target_fraction goal rather than the exchange one.
